primary.title: India once had no LTCG tax: How income tax rules on LTCG, STCG and STT changed over the years
primary.summary: India’s capital gains tax regime has undergone several changes over the decades, from its abolition in 1949 to the removal of LTCG tax on listed equities in 2004 and its reintroduction in 2018.

related.title: Income Tax Returns: 'How India filed in 2026' - 5 trends that reveal how young investors, salaried earners manage money
related.summary: India's income tax filing data reveals five changing money trends: more Indians are earning beyond salaries, young taxpayers are filing complex returns, low-income earners are reporting diverse income sources, young investors are reporting losses and retirees continue investing.
